info.title: Gaffer dispatch API
info.description:
The control plane's REST surface: tickets and their gates, the Factory Map scope graph, plan sessions, epics and specs, repositories, runner actions, configuration, read models and the live event stream.

**Authentication.** Every data route requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Two credentials exist: the **full** token (`DISPATCH_API_TOKEN`, or `$GAFFER_DATA/dashboard-token`) and a **read-scoped** token derived from it one-way (`dispatch-api print-read-token`) that may call GET routes only; a mutating call with the read token is refused with 403 `READ_ONLY_TOKEN`. Each operation's `x-capability` says which it needs (`public`, `read`, `full`). Token-less requests are also subject to a Host/Origin check (403 `FORBIDDEN_HOST`).

**Errors** are `{ error: { code, message, details? } }` with a stable `code`; 422 is validation, 409 a state-machine or claim conflict, 404 an unknown resource.

**Actors.** The API acts as one operator identity; there is no per-user RBAC. Response bodies are described by the TypeScript view type they serialise (named in each description) rather than schema'd.
